releases.name: Version 1.2.0
releases.body:
Finally, the long awaited Voice Acting update! You'll need the [Voice Acting Mod](https://outerwildsmods.com/mods/voiceactingmod/) for it to work.

* The mod is now almost fully voiced, including certain broadcasts
* A new side quest starting in the Magister's room
* Various visual improvements all over the ship
* The sealed room has been expanded
* The Magister is now more literate
releases.bodyZh:
最后，备受期待的配音更新终于来了！你需要[Voice Acting Mod](https://outerwildsmods.com/mods/voiceactingmod/)才能让它生效。

* 模组现在几乎完全配音，包括某些广播
* 一个新的支线任务将在大祭司的房间开始
* 船上到处都有各种视觉效果改进
* 密闭房间已经扩大
* 大祭司现在更有文化素养

releases.name: Version 1.1.4
releases.body:
* The floors have an improved sheen
* Getting around has been improved thanks to additional signage
* A pool now actually contains water rather than a simple illusory film at the top
* Other languages may know Ernesto's glory
* Chinese translation courtesy of Mashroom
* Korean translation courtesy of Barirn
* Removed Herobri- I mean Kirmby

Note: This does not include the Voice Acting update.
releases.bodyZh:
* 地板的光泽有所提升
* 得益于额外的标识，移动更加便捷
* 池塘现在实际含有水，而不再是顶部简单的幻影薄膜
* 其他语言可能知道埃尔内斯托的荣光
* 中文翻译由Mashroom提供
* 韩文翻译由Barirn提供
* 移除了Hero- 我的意思是Kirmby

注意：此更新不包括配音更新。

releases.name: Version 1.1.3
releases.body:
* Added some new decorations in Vespa's room. Thanks Pikpik!
* Fixed some text that wasn't properly translated
* Added REVERB to many places on the Magistarium
releases.bodyZh:
* 在维斯帕的房间中添加了一些新的装饰。感谢Pikpik！
* 修复了一些未正确翻译的文本
* 在马格斯特里움的许多地方添加了REVERB

releases.name: Version 1.1.2
releases.body:
* Hotfix to add pikpik_carrot and JohnCorby to the credits (forgot to add them in last update, whoops)
* Also properly set the planet to keepLoaded so that NH no longer creates a redundant parent sector
releases.bodyZh:
* 热补丁将 pikpik_carrot 和 JohnCorby 添加到鸣谢名单（上次更新时忘记添加了，哎呀）
* 还正确设置了星球以保持加载状态，这样 NH 就不再创建冗余的父区域

releases.name: Version 1.1.1
releases.body:
* Fixed performance of Library lighting
* Other minor visual improvements
* Sectoring, so overall performance should be better
releases.bodyZh:
* 修复了图书馆照明的性能问题
* 其他一些视觉效果改进
* 区域划分，整体性能应该会更好

releases.name: Version 1.1.0
releases.body:
* The Magistarium more closely matches its concept art
* Lily has a lot more to say in her room
* The Library lighting no longer looks terrible
* There is a new cube in the Library
* There is some additional signage to help navigation
* More post-game content
* Minor mesh and UV fixes
* Text edits
* Minor puzzle tweaks

releases.name: Version 1.0.2
releases.body:
* The Magister no longer knows how to snap.
* Vespa dismisses one of Roja's strange ideas
* Fixed various typos
* Space can no longer pull air out of thin air
* Fixed random frame drops (I think)
* You can no longer know what it is like to be a Sim in a pool
* Made a certain puzzle element more eye-catching
* Added credits

releases.name: Version 1.0.1
releases.body:
- Made a certain puzzle much harder to cheese. Blame TwoPintTom :bleh:
- Added new dialogue on the upper floor
- Added more to the postgame area

releases.name: Version 1.0.0
releases.body:
Initial release

Please test this one and report bugs, full *real* release will happen tomorrow ahead of the Jam deadline hopefully.
